verdict.detail: Same country, catalogue number and year as the first issue (UK, DATA001, 2015). Discogs lists 3 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

sides.value: THIS CITY WAS ONCE A PEACEFUL PLACE...
...UNTIL A POWERFUL SECRET CRIMINAL ORGANIZATION TOOK OVER

notes.text:
Comes on 180g vinyl with an obi strip on the cover. Comes with two lithographic prints featuring original artwork from the SEGA archives.

Initial orders will also include 5 cards featuring original character art, packaged in a hand-stamped envelope.

Audio sourced from the original NEC PC-88 files (A1, A2, A5, A7, A8, B1, B2, B6, B7) and a PAL Mega Drive (HD, VA4, non-TMSS) with Yamaha YM2612 sound chip, running at 60Hz through a stereo output mod (A3, A4, A6, B3, B4, B5, B8).

B-Side ends in a loop with the sound of picking up an extra life.

Japanese title reads 'Bea Nakkuru (Bare Knuckle) - Ikari No Tekken'
